passage: Modern diets often include hidden risks that we must understand to stay healthy. Many people believe that only sweet-tasting snacks contain sugar, but processed foods often hide sugar in savory items like sauces and bread. Similarly, while whole fruits provide essential fiber, fruit juice lacks this fiber and concentrates sugar, making it less healthy than eating the fruit itself. We must also be careful with packaged snacks fried in vegetable oil; even though the oil comes from plants, deep-frying significantly increases unhealthy fat content and calories. Furthermore, many students mistakenly think that energy drinks are perfect for recovery after sports, but these drinks are often loaded with sugar and do not replace the nutrients found in real food. Finally, it is a dangerous myth that health issues like diabetes or high blood pressure only affect the elderly. In reality, poor dietary habits can lead to chronic health problems at any age. We must also remember that sodium is a key component of salt, so foods labeled 'low-sodium' still contain salt and should be consumed in moderation. By choosing whole foods over processed alternatives, we can better manage our sugar and salt intake for a healthier future.

items.evidence: Many people believe that only sweet-tasting snacks contain sugar, but processed foods often hide sugar in savory items like sauces and bread.
items.q: Meena never eats sweets, but she eats bread with tomato sauce every day. What does this mean for the sugar she eats?
options: She still eats sugar hidden in these foods
She eats no sugar, as these foods taste salty
She eats sugar only when she adds it to tea
She gets only salt from them, never any sugar
items.explain: Processed foods hide sugar in savory items like sauces and bread, so Meena still eats sugar without tasting it.

wrong.why: thinks only sweet-tasting foods contain sugar
thinks sugar counts only when added to tea
over-generalises that savory foods contain only salt

items.evidence: Similarly, while whole fruits provide essential fiber, fruit juice lacks this fiber and concentrates sugar, making it less healthy than eating the fruit itself.
items.q: Priya drinks orange juice instead of eating whole oranges. How does this change what she gets?
options: She gets less fiber and more concentrated sugar
She gets the same goodness in an easier form
She gets more fiber because juice is concentrated
She gets less sugar because juice is mostly water
items.explain: Juice lacks the fiber of whole fruit and concentrates sugar, so it is less healthy than eating the orange.

wrong.why: thinks juice is as healthy as whole fruit
mixes up which thing is concentrated, fiber or sugar
thinks drinks are mostly water with little sugar

items.evidence: We must also be careful with packaged snacks fried in vegetable oil; even though the oil comes from plants, deep-frying significantly increases unhealthy fat content and calories.
items.q: Packaged chips are deep-fried in vegetable oil. What does the frying do to them?
options: It greatly raises their fat and calories
It keeps them healthy, as the oil is from plants
It removes fat, since plant oil is light
It adds hidden sugar, like in sauces
items.explain: Even though the oil comes from plants, deep-frying greatly increases unhealthy fat and calories in snacks.

wrong.why: thinks plant oil makes fried food healthy
reverses the effect of frying on fat
picks a nearby detail about hidden sugar

items.evidence: We must also remember that sodium is a key component of salt, so foods labeled 'low-sodium' still contain salt and should be consumed in moderation.
items.q: Aman buys crackers labelled 'low-sodium' and plans to eat the whole packet. What should he understand?
options: They still contain salt, so he should eat less
They contain no salt, so any amount is fine
They are safe if he adds no salt at table
They are safe because salt harms only old people
items.explain: Sodium is part of salt, so low-sodium foods still contain salt and should be eaten in moderation.

wrong.why: thinks low-sodium means no salt at all
thinks only salt added at the table counts
thinks salt only affects older people
